title: Video World Models Need Predictable Latents
abstract: arXiv:2610.34663v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video world models trained on large-scale robot data promise a safe and scalable approach for learning and evaluating policies that act in the physical world. However, they still struggle with long-horizon rollouts and out-of-distribution generalization, and they remain computationally demanding at inference time. Typically, video world models make predictions in the latent space of a reconstruction-trained autoencoder, which however is not directly optimized for dynamics modeling. On the other hand, world models designed for latent planning usually optimize latents to be predictable, but they forgo accurate prediction of observations in pixel space. In this paper, we show that it is possible to achieve the best of both worlds: a latent geometry optimized to make future prediction as simple as possible without sacrificing accurate prediction of future observations. translated_title: 视频世界模型需要可预测的潜在表示
translated_abstract: 在大规模机器人数据上训练的视频世界模型，为学习和评估作用于物理世界的策略提供了一种安全且可扩展的方法。然而，这类模型在长时程推演和分布外泛化方面仍面临困难，且在推理时计算开销较大。通常，视频世界模型在由重建训练的自编码器的潜在空间中进行预测，但该潜在空间并未针对动力学建模进行直接优化。另一方面，为潜在规划设计的世界模型通常将潜在表示优化得易于预测，却牺牲了对像素空间观测的准确预测能力。在本文中，我们证明了可以兼得两者的优势：通过优化潜在几何结构，使未来预测尽可能简单，同时不牺牲对未来观测的准确预测。更确切地说，我们发现用于表示学习的时间目标……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 提出优化潜在几何结构的方法，使视频世界模型的未来预测尽可能简单，同时保持对像素空间观测的准确预测，从而兼得潜在可预测性与观测重建精度两方面的优势。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that video world models can achieve the best of both worlds by optimizing latent geometry to make future prediction as simple as possible without sacrificing accurate prediction of future pixel-space observations, overcoming the trade-off between predictable latents and observation fidelity.
